title: Fund values shown 100x too high

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The nav_v2_endpoint flag (portfolio-service, 14:35 IST) switched to a NAV endpoint that returns paise, treated as rupees: fund values x100.

keyCounterevidence: market-data-service metrics are normal and it serves the same values; the v2 endpoint documents unit=paise.
The broker-connector quotes cache change affects stock quotes, but only fund values jumped.
redHerrings: broker-connector quotes cache change at 14:20 IST
notes: Unit mismatch, not data corruption upstream.
